title: Add a product
intro: Let's add products to your shop. Rex does the writing for you.

steps.caption: Tap Add a product
steps.vo: Go to Products and tap Add a product.

steps.caption: Take or choose photos
steps.vo: Take a photo, or tap Choose photos to pick up to six from your gallery.

steps.caption: Rex names and prices them
steps.vo: Rex names and prices each product from your photos. If Rex isn't sure, it says Check the price. Tap Edit to change anything.

steps.caption: Put them in your shop
steps.vo: When everything looks right, tap Put 3 products in my shop.

steps.caption: Change stock anytime
steps.vo: Your products are now in your shop. Use the plus and minus buttons to change how many you have in stock.

outro: Clear photos sell better, so take them in good light.
